fastchunkgen.option.globalExecutorParall: Worker threads used for chunk generation and IO.
fastchunkgen.option.threadedWorldGen.all: Generate features like trees, ores and structures in parallel.
fastchunkgen.option.threadedWorldGen.red: Lock fewer neighbouring chunks per generation step for more parallelism.
fastchunkgen.option.threadedWorldGen.asy: Schedule generation tasks off the server thread.
fastchunkgen.option.threadedLighting.ena: Run light updates on a dedicated thread.
fastchunkgen.option.ioSystem.async.toolt: Load and unload chunks off the server thread.
fastchunkgen.option.ioSystem.replaceImpl: Use the rewritten chunk IO implementation.
fastchunkgen.option.ioSystem.serializeBl: Snapshot block entity data on the server thread. Turning this off is faster but can corrupt modded block entities.
fastchunkgen.option.ioSystem.fireForgeCh: Fire Forge ChunkDataEvent.Save on async saves. Off means mods lose per-chunk data.
fastchunkgen.option.ioSystem.forgeChunkD: Chunk Data Events On Server Thread
Fire Forge chunk data events on the server thread. Off is unsafe for most mods.
fastchunkgen.option.ioSystem.chunkDataCa: Cached chunk writes before flushing to disk starts.
Hard cap on cached chunk writes.
fastchunkgen.option.ioSystem.chunkStream: Compression for newly saved chunks. -1 vanilla, 1 GZip, 2 Zlib, 3 none.
fastchunkgen.option.generalOptimizations: Serve off-thread chunk requests without blocking the server thread.
Apply our world generation allocation patches ahead of ModernFix's equivalent ones.
Nanoseconds between chunk tasks run inside the tick loop.
Vanilla saves every tick, Enhanced saves during idle time, Periodic saves every 6000 ticks.
Milliseconds before a dirty chunk is auto-saved. Enhanced mode only.
fastchunkgen.option.vanillaWorldGenOptim: Cheaper random instances during world generation.
fastchunkgen.option.fixes.generalThreadi: Fix thread-safety issues in the vanilla chunk system.
fastchunkgen.option.fixes.chunkIoThreadi: Fix thread-safety issues in vanilla chunk IO.
fastchunkgen.option.fixes.worldGenThread: Fix thread-safety issues in vanilla world generation. Required by threaded world generation.
fastchunkgen.option.fixes.disableLogging: Remove the log4j2 shutdown hook and force exit if a dedicated server hangs.
fastchunkgen.option.fixes.enforceSafeWor: Crash instead of warn when something uses the world random off-thread. For debugging.
fastchunkgen.option.ioSystem.gcFreeChunk: Allocation free chunk writer. Cannot fire Forge chunk data events, so mods lose per-chunk data.
fastchunkgen.option.ioSystem.recoverFrom: Regenerate chunks that fail to load. Destroys their contents.
